explication: MobSF is a Django-based mobile security research platform for Android, iOS, and Windows applications. A researcher or CI client submits an application through web or API entry points; authorization and sample handling precede static or dynamic analysis. Static pipelines parse platform artifacts, run security and malware checks, and persist findings. Dynamic pipelines control devices or Corellium, inject Frida instrumentation, optionally observe traffic, and generate reports. Results are stored for later web/API retrieval. Some orchestration links are inferred from the repository structure because only selected source files were sampled.
